additional_info.subject: RE: ID0418796-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R9 170002775] charger offline CRM:02679000114
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Eduard Huber,
Greetings of the day!
I have checked the charger on SCB and found it is currently offline on SCB but connected on OCPP. Unfortunately, we cannot perform any further remote actions without an active SCB connection.
As the next step, please perform a hard reset via the OCPP server if the charger is connected on OCPP. If a remote reset via OCPP is not possible, a local reboot will be necessary to bring the charger back online.
If the charger remains offline after these actions, we will need to schedule a site visit to inspect the router settings and check the network signal strength.
Please let us know if further assistance is required.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
